steps.code:
# Get all pending payment requests, paginating through all pages
all_pending = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_pending.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total pending requests: {len(all_pending)}")
# Filter those created in May 2023
may_requests = [req for req in all_pending if req['created_at'].startswith('2023-05')]
print(f"Pending requests in May 2023: {len(may_requests)}")
for req in may_requests:
    print(req['payment_request_id'], req['amount'], req['created_at'])
